summary: Revenue Management Solutions (RMS), with more than 25 years in the market, provides AI-powered menu pricing, competitor price intelligence, and financial-insights software (Price Studio, Competitor Price Intelligence, metiRi) to more than 100,000 restaurant locations across 40+ countries, and holds five US patents on menu pricing and customer segmentation.
John Oakes is CEO of Revenue Management Solutions.

RMS launched a Competitor Price Intelligence solution built on a proprietary Restaurant Price Index that benchmarks menu-price evolution across as many as 170,000 quick-service, fast-casual, casual-dining, and fine-dining locations.
